keyPhrases.text: If only film star George Clooney and his co-script writer Grant Heslov had hired an actual playwright
What worked in close-up in the film does not have the same effect on the huge stage
most of the characters are undefined or unidentified
At times it is difficult to know who is talking
most powerful of any play currently on Broadway

reasoning: While the review acknowledges the importance of the message and calls it 'the most powerful' play on Broadway, the criticism heavily outweighs praise. The reviewer criticizes the adaptation, staging, character development, and Clooney's performance. The opening 'If only...' sets a negative tone, and multiple technical/artistic flaws are identified.
